comparator: original native Branch M state, same emitted IDs, public graph reward
budget: All8 existing eligible Branch M roots; at most32 proposals/root, K<=2, at most128 future trajectories of32 tokens; no new reference search
stopping_rule: Complete the eight fixed roots. If no useful conditional reward is observed, do not enlarge this floor probe or train. Any R5 confirmation requires a separately frozen variance-based plan.
invalidation_conditions: Mismatch from saved first-block prefix, changed known prompt latents, token/KL violation, A/B overlap, root selection using future outcomes, or scorer mismatch invalidates the affected evidence
